notes.title: Poly Gangs Patch 0.0.3
notes.content:
Hi 
we are constantly working on making the game more efficient.

Below are the changes that are in the latest Patch:
1. Fixed sounds main menu keys.
2. Removed places slowing down walking in the DJ apartment.
3. Changing the DJ support respan.
4. Reworking the melee system (added the ability to aim fists - we hit the place where we are looking).
5. Repair of the radio (previously it did not turn on the first time we got into the car).
6. Getting rid of invisible blockers from the open world.
7. Improve the position of the rain.
8. Pause (ESC), pauses time in the game.

We hope that the gameplay is more and more enjoyable for you :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1480060/Poly_Gangs/

notes.title: Poly Gangs Patch 0.0.2
notes.content:
Patch 0.0.2, which includes:

1. Adding destroy system to cars
2. Repairing the dialogue with "Jelly Bean"
3. Improved loading of game settings (sensitivity fix, removal of the bug with resolution)
4. Improving the position of NPCs in the world (now they do not levitate and do not dig into the ground)
5. Optimize the game and improve the quality of Foliage on Enviro

Have a great game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1480060/Poly_Gangs/
